title: Local AI diagnostics and one-click Windows setup
scope: Dashboard Local AI and current OCR image path; does not install Live Translate, GPU drivers or other unrelated components.
privacy: Diagnostics are metadata-only on the configured validated loopback endpoint. Setup may access Microsoft WinGet / Ollama model registry only after the explicit setup action; no user text or image, account sign-in, cloud fallback, public bind, or background setup on page load.

acceptance: Show effective provider/address/model, server reachability, current model installation, and OCR image capability as supported, unsupported, or unknown; describe specific next action.
Use Ollama model metadata and a truthful llama.cpp advisory where reliable capability evidence is absent; never infer vision from a model name and do not transmit user content during checks.
Official Ollama gemma4:e2b supports image input. Test the end-to-end image request path on generated content and distinguish metadata, loopback contract, and verified real Gemma inference.

Explicit 'Cài phần còn thiếu' action describes source and multi-GB download, uses fixed official Ollama.Ollama WinGet package and local gemma4:e2b preset, only installs what is absent, with bounded steps and actionable progress/failures. Show the publisher, sources, and size before the click. Do not bypass integrity checks or silently accept unexpected agreements.

Only reuse a verified Ollama listener, not any process on the default port. Otherwise report the conflict. Start by absolute path with a child-only 127.0.0.1 bind and no-cloud flag. Never kill or reconfigure an existing Ollama or claim its cloud setting has been verified.

Do not overwrite nondefault providers, user model, prompt settings or concurrent edits; expose an explicit way to apply the ready preset and use normal save. No user-supplied program, command, install path, or pull target through IPC.
Check/list never triggers installation or any external network call. Stub the install boundary for routine CI; use a separate hosted Windows full installation smoke where practical.

Use OS trusted absolute executable paths and expected Ollama publisher/identity; no PATH or working-directory search, arbitrary args, shell fragments, elevation or force. Fail closed on missing trust or uncertain ownership.

Use a background bounded single-flight operation shared across dashboard processes, observable progress and cancellation limited to owned work. Test missing provider, unexpected listener, failed install, timeout, and duplicate setup.
Independent strong Advisor reviews plan before coding and implementation before merge.
Pass Rust tests and real WebView2 tests for check, progress, retry, unchanged settings and image request, plus full Windows regression and extracted ZIP smoke.
Record the exact verified head and actual evidence in this JSON; only then merge through an expected-head lease.
